title: Prepare wavefunk-ui components for AllowThem template migration
description: Epic for closing the component/API gaps identified in docs/wavefunk-ui-template-migration-readiness.md. Treat /home/nambiar/projects/wavefunk/ui version 0.1.2 at 769a7ba as canonical. Generic reusable primitives belong in wavefunk-ui; AllowThem owns auth-specific composition, copy, routes, and domain view models.

title: Extract generic split-form shell primitives
description: Add only generic Askama primitives to wavefunk-ui for split/form shells, narrow form panels, tabs, provider-button grids, legal/footer helpers, and HTMX-aware links. AllowThem should compose login/register/password/MFA/consent pages, copy, routes, and OAuth semantics locally.

title: Decide shared branded splash primitives
description: Decide whether shader/iframe splash support is a generic wavefunk-ui media/splash primitive or an AllowThem-specific branded-login extension. If shared, add neutral split-panel/media primitives and runtime asset support; keep branding precedence and auth defaults in AllowThem.

title: Add modeline and mode-toggle components
description: Add generic typed Modeline and ModelineSegment support to wavefunk-ui, including optional action segments, [data-mode-toggle] support, and minibuffer history if generally useful. AllowThem owns labels such as AT, session/logout behavior, and auth environment status text.

title: Extend app shell for AllowThem chrome
description: Extend or wrap wavefunk-ui AppShell with generic support for mode-locked html attrs, anchor brands, pageheader slots, main layout modifiers, and modeline+minibuffer footer layout. AllowThem owns role-specific nav, routes, and shell context.

title: Add generic workspace navigation primitives
description: Add generic workspace/project switcher plus Sidenav/SidenavSection/SidenavItem components for sidebar navigation, including muted and coming-soon states. AllowThem owns tenant role labels, tenant route construction, and permission-filtered nav composition.

title: Map legacy form aliases to typed components
description: Migrate or alias legacy AllowThem form classes such as wf-formfield, wf-form-row, wf-help, wf-hint, wf-flash, wf-flash-warn, wf-btn-primary, and wf-link/link-quiet. Prefer existing wavefunk-ui typed components unless exact HTML compatibility is required.

title: Add generic security display primitives
description: Add only reusable security-adjacent display primitives to wavefunk-ui: check-list display, credential/secret copy or reveal pattern, and recovery-code grid/list if generally useful. AllowThem owns OAuth consent semantics, credential labels, recovery-code lifecycle, and security copy.

title: Replace legacy list pager and table chrome
description: Map AllowThem's wf-pager*, wf-filter-form, wf-tablefoot, wf-tag-remove, and row action markup to existing DataTable, FilterBar, Pagination, TableFooter, BulkActionBar, and RowSelect APIs, adding wavefunk-ui gaps only if needed.
